title: Reverse Words in a String
statement_short: Given an input string s containing words separated by spaces, reverse the order of the words. Return a string of the words joined by a single space with no leading or trailing spaces.
constraints: 1 <= s.length <= 10^4, s contains English letters, digits, and spaces ' ', at least one word
hint: String length up to 10^4 requires an O(n) algorithm, achievable in-place using two-pointer segment reversals.
keywords: reverse the order of the words
why_not: Right: Two Pointers reverses the whole character sequence and then reverses each individual word in-place in O(n) time and O(1) extra space. Not Stack: Pushing words onto a stack reverses word order but consumes O(n) auxiliary memory. Not Sliding Window: The task modifies word sequence order rather than maintaining a continuous subsegment. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Hash tables do not assist with word position swaps or string reversal.
